test_framework: Vitest with vi.mock, vi.fn patterns. Tests co-located with source files as *.test.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run yarn workspace web typecheck. 2. Run yarn workspace web test. Both must pass.
setup_instructions: corepack enable && yarn workspaces focus web
environment_constraints: No docker daemon available. Network available for npm packages. FFmpeg is available (CI installs it).
contribution_requirements: Branch from current branch fix/openai-strict-schema. TypeScript strict mode. Tests required.
key_patterns: - Storage uses SigV4 presigning (apps/web/src/app/api/utils/storage.ts) with presignUpload/presignDownload. - TTS upload pattern: generate buffer -> presignUpload(key) -> PUT body -> presignDownload(key). - Image gen returns string URL or null. - Pipeline functions are tested with vi.mock for external deps. - The orchestrate pipeline updates DB status at each step.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/web is the Next.js app. Key paths: src/lib/assets/ (image handling), src/lib/ugc/ (video pipeline), src/lib/tts/ (text-to-speech), src/app/api/utils/ (storage, AI helpers).
